questions_for_hospital: Has Bayside Home Infusion or Coastline Home Health accepted the patient, and what is the first visit date and time at our site?
Who will give the cefazolin every 8 hours (agency RN or patient with an elastomeric pump), and if the patient, has she been taught and shown she can do it?
Who will do the forearm wound packing and how often; will home health wound care visits start within 24 hours of arrival?
Can you send the PT evaluation once done, including whether she can walk at least 100 ft?
Can nursing confirm she is independent with showering, hygiene and toileting?
Can you send a COVID test result from within 24 hours of the actual arrival time?
Is the patient on any isolation precautions?
Has the patient had any suicidal ideation or hallucinations, and any history of conservatorship or Full Service Partnership (FSP)?
Who will draw the weekly CBC/BMP and get her to the ID clinic visit on 06/15?

claude_fit.reason: Clinically a reasonable recuperative care case (bacteremia cleared, stable vitals, INF-1 met), but OTH-3, ID-3, INT-E2 and INT-E3 are not met because no home health or infusion agency has accepted, despite the form saying it is arranged. MOB-2 is not met and MOB-3/ADL-1 are unknown because PT has not seen her, so re-review once home health, PT notes and a fresh COVID swab are in.
